title: Travel, problems & emergencies
goal: Handle hotels, tickets and travel problems, ask for help in an emergency, and use 'if… then…' sentences.
intro:
Travelling in Sindh — to the shrines of Sehwan and Bhit Shah, the Makli tombs, the Thar desert or the Indus at Sukkur — you will need to book rooms, buy tickets, and occasionally deal with lost bags or a sick companion. This unit gives you the survival language, and the grammar of **conditions**: **جيڪڏهن … ته …** 'if … then …'.

Emergency numbers in Pakistan: **15** for police, **1122** for rescue/ambulance in Sindh's cities, **115** for the Edhi ambulance service.

vocab.note: Invariable. بند ڪرڻ = to close, switch off.
f. چوري ٿيڻ = to be stolen.
Invariable. گم ٿيڻ = to get lost.

vocab.en: to lose one's way; to forget
vocab.note: مان رستو ڀلجي ويو آهيان = I've lost my way (m).
f. باهه لڳي آهي = there's a fire.
Answered by ته ta 'then'. Also جيڪر jekar (esp. for unreal 'if').

grammar.title: Real conditions: جيڪڏهن … ته …
grammar.body:
A Sindhi condition has two halves: **جيڪڏهن** (jekaɗahiṃ) 'if' starts the first, and **ته** (ta) 'then' starts the second. Unlike English, the 'then' is almost never left out.

The if-clause can use:
• the **present**: جيڪڏهن توهان وٽ وقت آهي ته … 'if you have time, …'
• the **subjunctive** (present without ٿو) for possible future events: جيڪڏهن هو اچي ته … 'if he comes, …'
• very commonly, the **past** form for future possibilities: جيڪڏهن مينهن پيو ته … 'if it rains (lit. if rain fell), …'

The then-clause is usually **future** or **imperative**: … ته اسين نه وينداسين / ته مون کي فون ڪجو.

**نه ته** (na ta) means 'otherwise': جلدي ڪريو، نه ته ٽرين نڪري ويندي 'hurry, otherwise the train will leave'.

examples.native: جيڪڏهن مينهن پيو ته اسين گهر ۾ رهنداسين.
examples.roman: jekaɗahiṃ mīṃhu peyo ta asīṃ ghara meṃ rahandāsīṃ.
examples.en: If it rains, we'll stay at home.

examples.native: جيڪڏهن ڪا تڪليف ٿي ته مون کي فون ڪجو.
examples.roman: jekaɗahiṃ kā takalīfa thī ta moṃ khe fon kajo.
examples.en: If there's any problem, call me.

examples.native: جيڪڏهن توهان وٽ وقت آهي ته اسان سان هلو.
examples.roman: jekaɗahiṃ tavhāṃ vaṭi vaqtu āhe ta asāṃ sāṃ halo.
examples.en: If you have time, come with us.

examples.native: جيڪڏهن هو اچي ته هن کي ويهارجو.
examples.roman: jekaɗahiṃ hū ache ta hun khe vehārijo.
examples.en: If he comes, please seat him / ask him to wait.

examples.native: جلدي ڪريو، نه ته ٽرين نڪري ويندي.
examples.roman: jaldī karyo, na ta ṭreni nikirī vendī.
examples.en: Hurry up, otherwise the train will leave.

grammar.title: Unreal conditions: 'if I had…, I would…' with ها
grammar.body:
For situations that are **not true** (imagined, or regrets about the past), Sindhi often uses **جيڪر** (jekar) or جيڪڏهن, and adds the little particle **ها** (hā) to the verbs in **both** halves:

جيڪر مون کي خبر هجي ها ته مان اچان ها — 'if I had known, I would have come'

The verb before ها is in the subjunctive form (هجي، اچان، ڪريان…). It's an advanced structure — recognise it when you hear it; for your own speech the simple جيڪڏهن … ته … will carry you a long way.

examples.native: جيڪر مون وٽ پئسا هجن ها ته مان گهر وٺان ها.
examples.roman: jekar moṃ vaṭi paisā hujan hā ta māṃ gharu vaṭhāṃ hā.
examples.en: If I had money, I'd buy a house.

examples.native: جيڪر توهان ٻڌايو ها ته مان توهان کي اسٽيشن تي وٺڻ اچان ها.
examples.roman: jekar tavhāṃ ɓudhāyo hā ta māṃ tavhāṃ khe isṭeshana te vaṭhaṇa achāṃ hā.
examples.en: If you had told me, I'd have come to pick you up at the station.

examples.native: جيڪر مينهن نه پوي ها ته اسين وڃون ها.
examples.roman: jekar mīṃhu na pave hā ta asīṃ vañūṃ hā.
examples.en: If it weren't raining, we'd go.

dialogue.title: A lost bag at Sukkur station
dialogue.setting: Sarah arrives at Sukkur railway station and can't find her bag. She speaks to a railway policeman.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.native: معاف ڪجو، سائين. منهنجو ٿيلهو گم ٿي ويو آهي.
lines.roman: māf kajo, sāīṃ. munhinjo thelho gumu thī vayo āhe.
lines.en: Excuse me, sir. My bag has gone missing.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.native: ڪٿي هو؟ ٽرين ۾ يا پليٽ فارم تي؟
lines.roman: kithe ho? ṭreni meṃ yā pleṭfārma te?
lines.en: Where was it? On the train or on the platform?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.native: ٽرين ۾، منهنجي سيٽ جي هيٺان. ڪراچيءَ کان آئيس.
lines.roman: ṭreni meṃ, munhinjī sīṭa jī heṭhāṃ. karāchīa khāṃ āīs.
lines.en: On the train, under my seat. I came from Karachi.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.native: پريشان نه ٿيو. ٽرين اڃا پليٽ فارم تي بيٺي آهي. هلو، ڳوليون ٿا.
lines.roman: pareshānu na thiyo. ṭreni añā pleṭfārma te bīṭhī āhe. halo, ɠolyūṃ thā.
lines.en: Don't worry. The train is still standing at the platform. Come, let's look.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.native: هي ڏسو — نيرو ٿيلهو. توهان جو آهي؟
lines.roman: hī ɗiso — nīro thelho. tavhāṃ jo āhe?
lines.en: Look at this — a blue bag. Is it yours?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.native: ها! اهو ئي آهي! توهان جي ڏاڍي مهرباني!
lines.roman: hā! uho ī āhe! tavhāṃ jī ɗāḍhī meharbānī!
lines.en: Yes! That's the one! Thank you so much!

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.native: جيڪڏهن ٻيهر ڪا تڪليف ٿي ته ٿاڻي تي اچجو.
lines.roman: jekaɗahiṃ ɓiyahar kā takalīfa thī ta thāṇe te achijo.
lines.en: If you have any trouble again, come to the police post.

culture: Sindh's great pilgrimage sites welcome travellers of every faith: the shrine of **Lal Shahbaz Qalandar** at Sehwan, famous for its ecstatic evening *dhamāl* drumming and dancing; **Bhit Shah**, resting place of Shah Abdul Latif; the **Makli necropolis** near Thatta, one of the largest funerary sites in the world; and **Sadhu Bela**, a Hindu temple complex on an island in the Indus at Sukkur. Sindhi people are famously helpful to strangers — if you're lost, ask at a shop, a mosque or a tea stall, and someone will usually take you there personally.

lessons.title: Tickets, trains and papers

tip.title: Ticket for, train from
tip.body:
- A ticket *for* a place = **لاءِ**: سکر **لاءِ** ٽڪيٽ.
- Leaving *from* a platform = **تان** (off, from on top of): ٻئي پليٽ فارم **تان**.
- One ٽڪيٽ, two **ٽڪيٽون**.

new: ٽرين ڪهڙي پليٽ فارم تان ويندي؟
مون کي پنهنجي سفارتخاني سان ڳالهائڻو آهي.

sentences.native: ٽرين ٻئي پليٽ فارم تان ويندي.
sentences.roman: ṭreni ɓie pleṭ fārma tāṃ vendī.
sentences.en: The train leaves from platform two.
Do you need a visa for Pakistan?

sentences.native: منهنجي ويزا ختم ٿي وئي آهي.
sentences.roman: munhinjī vīzā xatmu thī vaī āhe.

tip.title: جيڪڏهن … ته …
tip.body:
- **جيڪڏهن** 'if' starts the first half, **ته** 'then' starts the second — keep the ته.
- The if-half can be present, the verb without ٿو, or even past: جيڪڏهن وقت **مليو** ته … 'if we get time…'.
- The then-half is usually future or a request.
- **نه ته** = otherwise: جلدي ڪريو، **نه ته** …

sentences.native: جيڪڏهن توهان رستو ڀلجي وڃو ته مون کي فون ڪجو.
sentences.roman: jekaɗahiṃ tavhāṃ rasto bhulijī vaño ta moṃ khe fon kajo.
sentences.en: If you lose your way, give me a call.

sentences.native: جيڪڏهن هتي خطرو آهي ته اسين ٻئي هوٽل ۾ هلون.
sentences.roman: jekaɗahiṃ hite xatiro āhe ta asīṃ ɓie hoṭala meṃ halūṃ.
sentences.en: If it's dangerous here, let's go to another hotel.

sentences.native: جيڪڏهن بس نه آئي ته ٽيڪسي وٺنداسين.
sentences.roman: jekaɗahiṃ basa na āī ta ṭaiksī vaṭhandāsīṃ.
sentences.en: If the bus doesn't come, we'll take a taxi.

sentences.native: جيڪڏهن توهان کي بک لڳي ته ماني کائو.
sentences.roman: jekaɗahiṃ tavhāṃ khe bukha laɠe ta mānī khāo.
sentences.en: If you get hungry, have something to eat.

sentences.native: جيڪڏهن وقت مليو ته ڀٽ شاهه وينداسين.
sentences.roman: jekaɗahiṃ vaqtu milyo ta bhiṭ shāh vendāsīṃ.
sentences.en: If we get time, we'll go to Bhit Shah.

sentences.native: جلدي ڪريو، نه ته دير ٿي ويندي.
sentences.roman: jaldī karyo, na ta dera thī vendī.
sentences.en: Hurry up, or we'll be late.

sentences.native: رات جو ٻاهر نه وڃو، خطرو آهي.
sentences.roman: rāti jo ɓāhari na vaño, xatiro āhe.
sentences.en: Don't go out at night, it's dangerous.

lessons.title: Lost and stolen

tip.title: It got lost, it was stolen
tip.body:
- Things *get* lost or stolen — the verb agrees with the thing: فون **گم ٿي ويو**، ڪنجي **گم ٿي وئي**، پئسا **چوري ٿي ويا**.
- Add **آهي** for 'has been': چوري ٿي ويو **آهي**.
- **پوليس** is feminine: پوليس اچي **رهي** آهي.

new: منهنجو سامان گم ٿي ويو آهي.

sentences.native: منهنجي ٽڪيٽ گم ٿي وئي آهي.
sentences.roman: munhinjī ṭikeṭa gumu thī vaī āhe.

sentences.native: منهنجو فون چوري ٿي ويو آهي.
sentences.roman: munhinjo fon chorī thī vayo āhe.

sentences.en: Which way did the thief go?
There was a theft on the bus.

lessons.title: Emergencies

tip.title: Getting help fast
tip.body:
- Shout **بچايو!** 'help!' and **مدد ڪريو!**
- Call someone = … **کي سڏيو**; send for an ambulance = ايمبولينس **گهرايو**.
- Numbers: **15** police, **1122** rescue and ambulance, **115** Edhi.

new: جلدي ايمبولينس گهرايو، هو زخمي آهي.

sentences.en: The ambulance will be here soon.

sentences.roman: hādise meṃ ko zaxmī na thiyo.
sentences.en: No one was hurt in the accident.

sentences.native: پريشان نه ٿيو، توهان محفوظ آهيو.
sentences.roman: pareshānu na thiyo, tavhāṃ mahfūzu āhyo.

tip.title: جيڪر … ها — things that didn't happen
tip.body:
- For imagined or missed chances use **جيڪر** 'if' and put **ها** after the verb in **both** halves.
- The verbs take the 'may I' form: هجي، اچان، ڪري.
- جيڪر مون کي خبر **هجي ها** ته مان **اچان ها** = if I'd known, I'd have come.
tip.pattern: جيڪر + verb + ها، ته + verb + ها

sentences.native: جيڪر مون کي خبر هجي ها ته مان توهان کي ٻڌايان ها.
sentences.roman: jekar moṃ khe xabara huje hā ta māṃ tavhāṃ khe ɓudhāyāṃ hā.
sentences.en: If I'd known, I would have told you.

sentences.native: جيڪر پاسپورٽ هوٽل ۾ هجي ها ته گم نه ٿئي ها.
sentences.roman: jekar pāsporṭu hoṭala meṃ huje hā ta gumu na thie hā.
sentences.en: If the passport had been in the hotel, it wouldn't have got lost.

sentences.native: جيڪر مون وٽ وقت هجي ها ته مان به اچان ها.
sentences.roman: jekar moṃ vaṭi vaqtu huje hā ta māṃ bi achāṃ hā.
sentences.en: If I'd had time, I'd have come too.

sentences.native: جيڪر اسين جلدي نڪرون ها ته ٽرين ملي وڃي ها.
sentences.roman: jekar asīṃ jaldī nikirūṃ hā ta ṭreni milī vañe hā.
sentences.en: If we'd left early, we'd have caught the train.

sentences.native: جيڪر هو هتي هجي ها ته اسان جي مدد ڪري ها.
sentences.roman: jekar hū hite huje hā ta asāṃ jī madada kare hā.
sentences.en: If he were here, he would help us.

sentences.native: جيڪر توهان ٿاڻي تي شڪايت ڪريو ها ته پوليس ڳولي ها.
sentences.roman: jekar tavhāṃ thāṇe te shikāyata karyo hā ta pulīsa ɠole hā.
sentences.en: If you'd reported it at the police station, the police would have looked for it.
We looked for the passport all day.
Make a complaint at the police station.
